findings.title: Potential Broken Authentication
findings.description: Handler "impersonate" creates an authenticated session from client-controlled identity "req.query.userId" without verifying user credentials.
evidence: 4. Credential verification (e.g. bcrypt.compare or password validation) was NOT found in this execution path.
5. Route allows arbitrary callers to impersonate identities by supplying a user identifier.
findings.recommendation: Disable or remove this insecure demo impersonation endpoint, or require proper multi-factor credential validation before issuing authentication tokens.
